openMythosRuntime.title: OpenMythos Runtime
openMythosRuntime.subtitle: Tune adaptive effort, frozen task cards, and skill routing hints for Argus sessions.

constraints.keepGoal: Keep the current user goal visible before each major action.
constraints.noRevert: Do not revert unrelated user changes.
constraints.safeChange: Before editing, identify the smallest safe change and the verification path.

acceptance.changed: State what changed or what was found.
acceptance.tests: Report tests or checks run, or explain why they were not run.

routes.security: Use a security-focused skill or reviewer before reporting completion.
routes.verification: Use a verification pass for migration, rollout, or CI-sensitive changes.
routes.performance: Route to a performance, async, or profiling skill when available.
routes.architecture: Use Explore/Plan agents for broad codebase research before edits.
routes.test: Run focused tests or a verification agent after edits.
routes.git: Preserve existing worktree changes and report git state explicitly.
routes.frontend: Use frontend/design guidance and verify the rendered UI when available.
routes.local: Handle locally; avoid spawning agents unless a specific side task appears.
routes.routed: Use skill/subagent routing only for distinct work that can run in parallel or protect main context.
